svg.title: Kingsfield three-layer agent architecture
svg.desc: Three separate agent systems with distinct triggers and purposes: Legal Crew during work, Verification Council at the gate, LLM Council on meta-decisions.

g.text: Runs during work. 4 specialists produce the deliverable.
Runs at the gate before any filing. Skeptic always; others on demand.
Witness, Translator, Historian — convened on filings
Runs on meta-decisions only. User triggers explicitly.
